IdempotencyRecord_response_state_check.name: IdempotencyRecord_response_state_check
IdempotencyRecord_response_state_check.value: ("IdempotencyRecord"."state" = 'in_progress' and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseJson" is null and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseStatus" is null) or ("IdempotencyRecord"."state" = 'completed' and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseJson" is not null and jsonb_typeof("IdempotencyRecord"."responseJson") = 'object' and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseJson"->>'kind' in ('plain_json', 'encrypted_json') and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseStatus" is not null and "IdempotencyRecord"."responseStatus" between 200 and 299)

RunReservation_state_timestamps_valid.name: RunReservation_state_timestamps_valid
RunReservation_state_timestamps_valid.value: ("RunReservation"."state" = 'reserved' and "RunReservation"."consumedAt" is null and "RunReservation"."releasedAt" is null) or ("RunReservation"."state" = 'consumed' and "RunReservation"."consumedAt" is not null and "RunReservation"."releasedAt" is null) or ("RunReservation"."state" = 'released' and "RunReservation"."consumedAt" is null and "RunReservation"."releasedAt" is not null)

RunnerRun_terminal_attempt_cleanup_idx.name: RunnerRun_terminal_attempt_cleanup_idx
RunnerRun_terminal_attempt_cleanup_idx.where: "RunnerRun"."dispatchState" = 'terminal' and "RunnerRun"."daytonaAttemptId" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is not null

RunnerRun_timestamps_valid.name: RunnerRun_timestamps_valid
RunnerRun_timestamps_valid.value: ("RunnerRun"."status" = 'queued' and "RunnerRun"."startedAt" is null and "RunnerRun"."completedAt" is null) or ("RunnerRun"."status" = 'running' and "RunnerRun"."startedAt" is not null and "RunnerRun"."completedAt" is null and "RunnerRun"."startedAt" >= "RunnerRun"."createdAt") or ("RunnerRun"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') and "RunnerRun"."completedAt" is not null and "RunnerRun"."completedAt" >= "RunnerRun"."createdAt" and ("RunnerRun"."startedAt" is null or ("RunnerRun"."startedAt" >= "RunnerRun"."createdAt" and "RunnerRun"."completedAt" >= "RunnerRun"."startedAt")))

RunnerRun_dispatchLease_valid.name: RunnerRun_dispatchLease_valid
RunnerRun_dispatchLease_valid.value: ("RunnerRun"."dispatchState" = 'queued' and "RunnerRun"."status" = 'queued' and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" is null) or ("RunnerRun"."dispatchState" = 'dispatching' and "RunnerRun"."status" = 'queued' and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" > "RunnerRun"."createdAt") or ("RunnerRun"."dispatchState" = 'running' and "RunnerRun"."status" = 'running' and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" > "RunnerRun"."createdAt") or ("RunnerRun"."dispatchState" = 'terminal' and "RunnerRun"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') and (("RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" is null) or ("RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseToken" is not null and "RunnerRun"."dispatchLeaseExpiresAt" is not null)))

RunnerRun_error_bounded.name: RunnerRun_error_bounded
RunnerRun_error_bounded.value: "RunnerRun"."error" is null or (jsonb_typeof("RunnerRun"."error") = 'object' and "RunnerRun"."error" ?& array['code', 'message', 'retryable'] and ("RunnerRun"."error" - 'code' - 'message' - 'retryable' - 'details') = '{}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("RunnerRun"."error"->'code') = 'string' and ("RunnerRun"."error"->>'code') = btrim("RunnerRun"."error"->>'code') and char_length("RunnerRun"."error"->>'code') between 1 and 64 and jsonb_typeof("RunnerRun"."error"->'message') = 'string' and ("RunnerRun"."error"->>'message') = btrim("RunnerRun"."error"->>'message') and char_length("RunnerRun"."error"->>'message') between 1 and 500 and jsonb_typeof("RunnerRun"."error"->'retryable') = 'boolean' and (not ("RunnerRun"."error" ? 'details') or (jsonb_typeof("RunnerRun"."error"->'details') = 'string' and ("RunnerRun"."error"->>'details') = btrim("RunnerRun"."error"->>'details') and char_length("RunnerRun"."error"->>'details') between 1 and 2000)))

RunnerRun_daytonaCommand_requires_sessio.name: RunnerRun_daytonaCommand_requires_session
RunnerRun_daytonaCommand_requires_sessio.value: "RunnerRun"."daytonaCommandId" is null or "RunnerRun"."daytonaSessionId" is not null

RunnerRun_daytonaSession_requires_attemp.name: RunnerRun_daytonaSession_requires_attempt
RunnerRun_daytonaSession_requires_attemp.value: "RunnerRun"."daytonaSessionId" is null or "RunnerRun"."daytonaAttemptId" is not null

RunnerScheduler_reconciliationLease_pair.name: RunnerScheduler_reconciliationLease_pair
RunnerScheduler_reconciliationLease_pair.value: ("RunnerScheduler"."reconciliationLeaseOwner" is null and "RunnerScheduler"."reconciliationLeaseExpiresAt" is null) or ("RunnerScheduler"."reconciliationLeaseOwner" is not null and "RunnerScheduler"."reconciliationLeaseExpiresAt" is not null)
